periods.analysis: Only 140 households used matching dollars in Q1, when the indoor winter market ran two Saturdays a month.
periods.recommendations: Offer matching dollars every week once the outdoor market opens.

periods.analysis: Use rose from 140 to 410 households once the outdoor market opened in May with weekly matching.
periods.recommendations: Add a farm stand at the Bayfront library.

periods.analysis: Use peaked at 655 households in Q3, the market's strongest season, up from 410 in Q2.
periods.recommendations: Plan the winter indoor market now and watch for a Q4 drop as outdoor stands close.
